children: posted on Friday a 19% increase in annual profit, as strong platinum group metal prices offset the impact of lower income from its coal, iron ore and manganese divisions.
The diversified South African miner's headline earnings came in at 3.201 billion rand ($200.31 million) in the year ended June 30, compared with 2.695 billion rand previously.
ARM said it will pay a final dividend of 7 rand per share, up from a payout of 6 rand per share last year.
